status_definition: VERIFIED only when both fixtures were actually executed within the hard timeout and their asserted exit status and diagnostic substrings held; otherwise UNVERIFIED.

ARITH-OVERFLOW.proof_rule: A signed add/sub/mul is admitted only when every operand's static range makes overflow impossible; otherwise STRICT rejects with CPLUS-ARITH.

ARITH-DIVZERO.proof_rule: A division/modulo is admitted only when the divisor is provably nonzero; a provably zero divisor is rejected by STRICT with CPLUS-ARITH.

BOUNDS-FIXED.proof_rule: A compile-time constant index i into a fixed array of length N is admitted only if 0 <= i < N; otherwise STRICT rejects with CPLUS-BOUNDS/CPLUS-SAFE-BOUNDS.

BOUNDS-HEAP.proof_rule: For a tracked heap allocation of S bytes passed to a callee, every dereference p[i] must be provable within S/sizeof(*p); interprocedural extent propagation rejects the violation.

BOUNDS-VLA.proof_rule: Constant-extent arrays and loop-tracked VLAs are admitted; a sizeof whose VLA operand has side effects is not a safe constant expression and is rejected.
BOUNDS-VLA.trusted_boundary: VLA extents are not part of the plain-C ABI contract; use a fixed extent or cplus-managed allocation with an explicit length field.

BOUNDS-DYNAMIC-RUNTIME.proof_rule: When no static extent proof exists, the operation is not admitted by proof; the emitted C+ guard checks the index against the tracked allocation length at run time and aborts on violation.
BOUNDS-DYNAMIC-RUNTIME.runtime_check: C+ runtime emits a bounds guard; violation aborts with "C+ error: index N is outside the bounds of 'p' (length L)".

NULL-DEREF.proof_rule: A dereference of a pointer known to be null on any reaching path is rejected; admitted programs must guard the pointer before dereference.

UNINIT-JOIN.proof_rule: Definite-assignment CFG analysis requires every variable to be assigned on every path reaching a read; a join with an unassigned path is rejected.

ALIAS-TYPEPUN.proof_rule: A dereference through an lvalue whose type is incompatible with the stored object's effective type is rejected (strict aliasing); byte copies via memcpy are admitted.

PROVENANCE-ESCAPE.proof_rule: A managed or borrowed pointer whose owner's scope ends at the return edge cannot escape that scope; returning the pointee by value is admitted.

LIFETIME-UAF.proof_rule: Once a tracked owner is released, any subsequent liveness check or dereference of the same pointer is a use-after-free and is rejected.

LIFETIME-DOUBLE-FREE.proof_rule: Each tracked owner must be released exactly once on each path; a second release of the same owner is rejected with CPLUS-OWNER.

LIFETIME-REALLOC.proof_rule: Raw realloc is rejected because failure loses the original block; the accepted form is the C+ managed reallocation helper with an explicit success check.
LIFETIME-REALLOC.trusted_boundary: cplus_realloc / cplus_realloc_registered are the trusted boundary for resize; the plain C realloc contract is not admitted in the strict subset.

FFI-FORMAT.proof_rule: The format argument of printf/fprintf/snprintf must be a string literal; a non-literal format string is rejected with CPLUS-FFI.
FFI-FORMAT.trusted_boundary: Untrusted text crosses the FFI boundary only as a %s argument to a literal format string.

RAII-SIGNAL-CALLBACK.proof_rule: A signal/callback handler body may only call async-signal-safe functions; a non-async-signal-safe call in such a handler is rejected with CPLUS-FFI.
RAII-SIGNAL-CALLBACK.trusted_boundary: Handler state is confined to volatile sig_atomic_t; all other work is deferred out of the callback.

RAII-DEFER-JUMP.proof_rule: Control flow (return/goto/break) must not leave a defer/resource cleanup block; such a jump is rejected so the cleanup always runs.

JOIN-PHI-BOUNDS.proof_rule: At a control-flow join (phi/conditional expression), the worst-case index over all arms must be within the callee's proven extent; a single out-of-range arm is rejected.

THREAD-RACE.proof_rule: A thread function may not write a shared global without synchronization; unsynchronized shared writes are rejected with CPLUS-FFI.
THREAD-RACE.trusted_boundary: Shared mutable state must be confined to one thread or passed through an explicit synchronization primitive.

FUNC-BOUNDARY-NULL.proof_rule: At a call boundary, an argument proven null cannot be passed to a callee that dereferences it; the call is rejected with CPLUS-LIFETIME.

FIELD-RESOURCE-COPY.proof_rule: A resource-typed field/container object is linear: it may be passed by address but not copied by value into a second owner; a value copy is rejected.
